messages:
maria-r: heads-up — planning staged switchover for new-model-v3 into the catalog tomorrow 02:00 UTC. want to align on region ordering and fallback ladder before i kick the deploy-bot.
alexg: can we do eu -> na -> apac? lower load in eu overnight, gives a chance to catch regressions.
jamal: sg. also propose canary in eu with 5% traffic for 30m then ramp to 50% for 2h before global.
priya_ops: agree on canary. we need explicit fallback ordering pinned so runtime doesn't do silly preference swaps if capacity blips.
deploy-bot: Deployment plan created: new-model-v3
- Canary: eu-west-1 5% -> 30m
- Stage 1: eu-west-1 50% -> 2h
- Stage 2: na-central 25% -> 1h
- Stage 3: apac-southeast 25% -> ramp
Pinlist: none (will use default fallback policy)
maria-r: ^ thanks. maria-r: can we instead set explicit fallback priority: (1) new-model-v3, (2) new-model-v2-quant, (3) legacy-3b? we want graceful degradation in that order.
alexg: +1. also add a hard rollback trigger: 5xx rate >1% OR p50 latency increase >40% vs baseline for 15m.
jamal: add token-loss/regression check: eval set error rate >2% for top-10 prompts -> pause rollout.
priya_ops: logging & alerts: make sure rl-monitoring has the canary tag and routes to #eng-oncall and #product-alerts.
sean-sre: noted. i'll pre-create PagerDuty runbook and set severity to P1 if the 1% 5xx threshold is hit.
deploy-bot: pinned fallback order updated by maria-r: ["new-model-v3","new-model-v2-quant","legacy-3b"]
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy window: 2024-06-18T02:00:00Z -> 2024-06-18T06:00:00Z
alexg: small note — for na stage 2, prefer draining old variant on nodes with HT off to avoid KV cache thrash.
jamal: ops detail: suggest 10m steady-state hold after each ramp step to observe resource traces.
priya_ops: added hold: 30m after canary ramp, 10m after each stage. also set rollout pause points at each step for manual override.
maria-r: here's the fallback snippet i'll check into the catalog config (copy):
```
"fallback_priority": [
  "new-model-v3",
  "new-model-v2-quant",
  "legacy-3b"
],
"rollback_triggers": {
  "error_rate_pct": 1.0,
  "latency_increase_pct": 40,
  "eval_regression_pct": 2.0
}
```
sean-sre: lgtm. pls ensure the runtime can respect explicit fallback_priority vs automatic capacity-based fallbacks.
alexg: runtime side — i'll push a quick check to ensure explicit fallback_priority overrides cost-based routing for this rollout only.
deploy-bot: canary rollout initiated (eu-west-1): 5% traffic -> new-model-v3
deploy-bot: monitor urls: https://monitoring.redwood/prod/canary/new-model-v3
jamal: watching. if we see p95 jump >2x within 10m we abort.
priya_ops: tagging product leads: @maria-r @alexg — will send release notes draft after canary green.
maria-r: post-canary checklist: 1) confirm no eval regressions, 2) confirm error/latency thresholds, 3) confirm fallback priority persisted, 4) bump canary -> stage1
alexg: i will be oncall for stage1. jamal / sean will you both be ready for rollback in na stage?
jamal: i'll be available, will prep rollback playbook (drain new-model-v3, pin old variant back to 100%).
sean-sre: i'll handle infra-side node drains and KV cache warmup on rollback.
deploy-bot: canary completed: 30m elapsed, no rollback triggers fired, eval_regression 0.4% < 2%
maria-r: good. proceeding to stage1 (eu-west-1 50%). starting now.
deploy-bot: stage1 started: eu-west-1 -> 50% traffic
priya_ops: marked post-canary release notes draft: "new-model-v3 enabled with staged rollout. fallback order pinned to preserve quality. Monitoring and rollback thresholds set." will paste full notes to #product after full ramp.
alexg: reminder: if any region shows sustained CPU >85% for 20m, throttle ramp and investigate.
jamal: copy. keeping an eye on p50/p95 and error rate.
deploy-bot: stage1 reached steady-state. no thresholds breached.
maria-r: proceeding to stage2 (na-central 25%). anyone object?
sean-sre: go ahead from infra side.
deploy-bot: stage2 started: na-central -> 25% traffic
deploy-bot: stage2 hold 10m
deploy-bot: stage2 hold complete. no anomalies.
priya_ops: starting final stage ramp to apac now.
deploy-bot: stage3 started: apac-southeast -> ramping to 25%
deploy-bot: rollout complete: new-model-v3 now live global at configured weights.
jamal: nice. will leave enhanced monitoring for 24h.
maria-r: final action items: - commit fallback_priority to catalog metadata - update release notes & changelog - run follow-up eval after 6h
alexg: i'll open PR to pin the model version for 7 days to avoid auto-rotation.
sean-sre: logged runbook and rollback tags in PagerDuty.
priya_ops: release notes posted to #product and #announcements. tagging customer success for heads-up.
maria-r: thanks team. great coordination. :tada:
